name: Bauernhof Angererhof
beschreibung: The Angererhof Farm in Bad Häring is an inn in Tirol. The farm combines agriculture with accommodation and dining. The accommodation offers guests the opportunity to experience rural life. Regional products are offered at the inn. The surrounding area is ideal for hiking and cycling tours. Bad Häring is also known for its thermal springs. The Angererhof is a typical inn in Tirol with an agricultural operation.
